name: stella
description: Self-knowledge for stella, the self-hosted AI assistant. Use when users ask about configuration, setup, onboarding, providers, models, agents, channels, webhooks, memory, schedules, workflows, goals, workers, skills, plugins, session compaction, notifications, self-update, multi-user behavior, or how stella works. Also use for changing models, setting up channels or webhooks, configuring providers, updating stella, onboarding, switching agents, reporting bugs, and goal status or acceptance.
